name: מערכת שתי משוואות לינאריות – מציאת x ו-y בווקטור (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Solve the following equations to find the values of \(x\) and \(y\)

\[ {{CT:0}}={{CT:1}} \]

\[ {{CT:2}}={{CT:3}} \]

\({{CT:4}}=\) [[input:ans]]
[[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Eliminate \(x\): multiply the equations so that \(x\) has the same coefficient in both, subtract to find \(y\), then substitute back to find \(x\).
Step 1 — The system
Number the equations:

\[ \begin{array}{lrcl} (1)\quad & {{CT:0}} &=& {{CT:5}}\\ (2)\quad & {{CT:2}} &=& {{CT:6}} \end{array} \]

Step 2 — Eliminating \(x\)
Multiply equation (1) by \({{CT:7}}\) and equation (2) by \({{CT:8}}\), so that \(x\) has the coefficient \({{CT:9}}\) in both:

\[ \begin{array}{lrcl} (1')\quad & {{CT:10}} &=& {{CT:11}}\\ (2')\quad & {{CT:12}} &=& {{CT:13}} \end{array} \]

Subtract (1') from (2'); the \(x\)-terms cancel:

\[ {{CT:14}} = {{CT:13}}-{{CT:11}} = {{CT:15}} \]

Dividing by \({{CT:16}}\):

\[ y=\frac{{{CT:15}}}{{{CT:16}}}={{CT:17}} \]

Step 3 — Substituting back to find \(x\)
Substituting \(y={{CT:17}}\) in equation (1):

\[ {{CT:18}}+{{CT:19}}={{CT:5}}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad {{CT:18}}={{CT:20}}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad x={{CT:21}} \]

Step 4 — Check and answer
Check in equation (2): \({{CT:7}}\cdot {{CT:21}}+{{CT:22}}\cdot {{CT:17}}={{CT:6}}\). So

\[ {{CT:4}}={{CT:23}} \]
